# SpiderDave Techno Bricks

A pixel-art sheet by SpiderDave, released under CC0 1.0 (public domain
dedication) on OpenGameArt; no attribution required (the page says credit
"SpiderDave" if wanted). Fetched 2026-11-13; contents unchanged.

| File | Source | sha256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TechnoBricks.png` (1024 x 768) | https://opengameart.org/content/techno-bricks | `8f9cb92cad55a09acb779584775a0f09460b208348532b226c47211a56c4f94e` |

1536 procedurally generated 16 x 16 bricks with matching tops in the
DawnBringer 32-colour palette (from the page's description). Laid out as
64 x 24 units of 16 x 32: a cap tile above a body tile. The page gives
#201620 as the mask colour; the file's mask pixels are (32, 23, 32).
